description: Quality scoring rubric for the software-development profile — one entry per deliverable stage (1–6). Required sections are H2 headings of profiles/software-development/templates/stages/*.md.

quality_criteria.description: Every repository has a pinned commit/ref or a disclosed dirty-tree snapshot
Every load-bearing claim in Business/Technology/Architecture/SDLC cites an EV-NNN evidence reference
Every unverifiable claim is labelled Hypothesis or Assumption with a confidence level

consistency_checks.description: Every EV-NNN cited in a context section has a matching row in the Evidence Ledger
System Inventory entries reappear as components in Architecture Context

generation_batches.title: Repository inventory & business/technology context
generation_batches.instruction: Pin every repository to an exact commit/ref, or disclose a dirty-tree snapshot explicitly. Ground business and technology claims in specific repository evidence — never describe the product generically. List systems/components in System Inventory using their actual names from the code.

generation_batches.title: Architecture, SDLC & baseline metrics
generation_batches.instruction: State explicitly which architecture claims are confirmed by code versus documentation-only. SDLC context must reflect actual CI/CD, branching and release configuration found in the repository, not a generic best-practice description. Baseline metrics need a value, source and confidence, or an explicit gap.

generation_batches.title: Evidence ledger & open gaps
generation_batches.instruction: Every EV-NNN referenced above must have a row here with repository, ref/commit, path/symbol and the claim it supports. Every assumption or hypothesis needs an explicit confidence level and decision impact.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Current behaviour cites specific Stage 1 evidence (EV-NNN), not a generic restatement
Every affected component/contract/data store is named individually
Every regression risk names the specific component it threatens and a likelihood/impact rating

consistency_checks.description: Affected components trace back to entries in the Stage 1 System Inventory or Technology Context
Constraints Confirmed do not contradict the Stage 0 exclusions

generation_batches.title: Behaviour gap & affected surface
generation_batches.instruction: Cite specific Stage 1 evidence for current behaviour. Name every affected component, API/contract and data store individually — never a generic 'the backend'.

generation_batches.title: Migration impact & risk
generation_batches.instruction: State whether migration is required and its shape. Every regression risk needs the specific component it threatens with a likelihood/impact rating. Record any constraint raised beyond Stage 0, or confirm none.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: At least one option reuses or extends an existing Stage 1 mechanism, or explains why none applies
A do-nothing/defer baseline is evaluated alongside proposed options
Recommendation names one OPT-NN and its weighted score against the runner-up
Every ADR has context, decision, consequences and alternatives considered

consistency_checks.description: Every option references the Stage 2 affected components/items it addresses
The critique pass references at least one Stage 1 evidence item or Stage 2 constraint

generation_batches.title: Reuse & options
generation_batches.instruction: First check the Stage 1 baseline for existing mechanisms that reduce the design space. Generate 2-4 substantively different options plus an explicit do-nothing/defer baseline, each referencing specific Stage 2 affected items. Criteria weights must sum to 100.

generation_batches.title: Evaluation, recommendation & ADRs
generation_batches.instruction: Score every option including do-nothing. The recommendation must name one OPT-NN with its weighted score against the runner-up. Draft an ADR for each key decision the recommendation implies. State the compatibility and migration approach concretely.

generation_batches.title: Critique pass
generation_batches.instruction: Re-examine the recommendation above against the Stage 1 evidence and Stage 2 constraints for a contradiction or unverified claim. State what was checked and what, if anything, was corrected.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Every FR has an acceptance criterion and appears in the RTM
Every roadmap phase has a dated, measurable milestone and a named owner
Execution Authorisation Status reflects only what was explicitly authorised in Step 4.3, never an assumed yes

consistency_checks.description: Every FR implements an ADR-NN named in Stage 3
Integration Points cover every system named in the Stage 1 System Inventory
Implementation cost is compared explicitly against the Stage 0 budget ceiling

generation_batches.title: Backlog & traceability
generation_batches.instruction: Decompose the Stage 3 recommendation into FR-NNN items with acceptance criteria, each implementing a named ADR-NN. Every FR must appear in the RTM with its affected component and test.

generation_batches.title: Integration, cost & roadmap
generation_batches.instruction: Cover every system from the Stage 1 System Inventory in Integration Points. Compare the effort/cost estimate explicitly to the Stage 0 budget ceiling. Every roadmap phase needs a dated milestone and a named owner.

generation_batches.title: Execution authorisation
generation_batches.instruction: Record exactly what the human authorised in Step 4.3 — do not assume authorisation was granted if the human did not explicitly say so.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Verification evidence states what actually ran, where, and its result, or explicitly states nothing has run
Every Critical/High risk has a named individual owner and a dated mitigation
Monitoring signals are specific to this change's expected effect, not generic uptime monitoring

consistency_checks.description: Verification evidence covers the FRs listed in Stage 4
Migration/rollback plan matches the Stage 3 compatibility & migration approach

generation_batches.title: Verification & operational plan
generation_batches.instruction: State only verification that actually happened, with command, environment and result — never assume a future pass. Migration/rollback must match the Stage 3 approach. Monitoring signals must be specific to this change's expected effect.

generation_batches.title: Risk register & release status
generation_batches.instruction: Every Critical/High risk needs a named owner and a dated mitigation. Release Decision Status must record merge and deployment as pending human decisions, never as already completed by this initiative.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.

quality_criteria.description: Deployment status is stated with evidence or explicitly marked not yet deployed
Every planned KPI has a measured value with source and window, or is explicitly marked pending
Baseline update proposal is specific enough to apply as a reviewable change to Stage 1

consistency_checks.description: KPIs measured here match the KPIs defined in Stage 0/Stage 4
Baseline update proposal references specific Stage 1 sections it would change

generation_batches.title: Deployment & outcome
generation_batches.instruction: State deployment status with evidence, or explicitly mark not yet deployed — never infer deployment from a merged PR/MR or passing CI alone. Every KPI needs a measured value with source and window, or an explicit pending status. Name any deviation between the Stage 4 plan and actual delivery.

generation_batches.title: Baseline update & related initiatives
generation_batches.instruction: Propose specific, applicable updates to the Stage 1 baseline based on what was actually delivered. Name any other initiative against the same product that this outcome or update may affect, or state none was identified.

generation_batches.title: Sign-off
generation_batches.instruction: Use the complete document above as context.
